title: The loop saves its dispatch state after a relaunch churn and launches other ready work
description: On a real temporary Postgres behind the served API, one item carries thousands of launch failures and a running session its runtime no longer lists, as the GY-3406 relaunch churn left it. Two loop cycles run the real dispatch tick: each saves the dispatch state through POST /api/loop-state/<scope>/dispatch without a 500, the churned item keeps only its latest launch failures, and another item's ready review launches.

steps.name: Two loop cycles save the dispatch state and launch the other ready item
